card.title: PlayStation 5 Single beep from power button every 30 seconds repair

source.title: PlayStation 5 Single beep from power button every 30 seconds repair

claims.statement: PS5 beeping once every 30 s: check fuse F7002 and the TLV62090RGTR 5 V→3.3 V converter opposite it (it and its cap commonly fail), liquid metal spills around the APU, caps behind the Wi-Fi/BT module, and around fuses F7502 and F7003.

procedure: Check TLV62090RGTR and its cap for shorts.
Check caps behind Wi-Fi/BT module and around F7003/F7502.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
